item.title: Reversible Sn4+/Sn0 anode for high-energy-density flow batteries
item.description:
آند برگشت‌پذیر Sn4+/Sn0 برای باتری‌های جریانی با چگالی انرژی بالا معرفی می‌شود که امکان ذخیره‌سازی انرژی کارآمد را فراهم می‌کند.
Nature Chemistry | 🔬 Research Article
💡 The novelty is using iodide to form SnI62− intermediates that make the Sn4+/Sn2+ couple reversible, enabling a four-electron Sn4+/Sn0 anode. This yields a high-energy-density tin-based aqueous flow battery with 205 Wh l−1 anolyte energy density, 89% energy efficiency, and a kilowatt-scale stack stable over 1,000 hours.
🏷 tin anode · flow battery · Sn4+/Sn0 redox · high energy density · reversible anode

item.title: A Coupled Electrolyte Design to Reconcile Multielectron Iodine Redox With Zn Anode Reversibility for Durable Aqueous Zinc‐Iodine Batteries
item.description:

SusMat | 🔬 Research Article | 🔓 Open Access
💡 This work couples choline chloride and acrylamide in ZnSO₄ electrolyte to simultaneously enable high-valence iodine redox via stable ICl intermediates and in situ form a PAM-Ch⁺ SEI on Zn. It reconciles multielectron iodine conversion with Zn reversibility, achieving 5000 h Zn stability and 6000-cycle Zn||I₂ durability, offering a design strategy for high-energy aqueous batteries.
🏷 zinc-iodine battery · electrolyte design · multielectron redox · solid electrolyte interphase · Zn anode reversibility

💡 This work pioneers holistic upcycling of mixed spent batteries by coupling composition-tunable NMC622 resynthesis with graphite purification and surface modification, validated in full pouch cells. It achieves doubled cycle life, >95% material utilization, 22.9% higher profit, and reduced emissions and energy, establishing mixed waste as viable feedstock for value-added, circular battery remanufacturing.

Advanced Energy Materials | 🔬 Research Article
💡 This work pioneers phenothiazine–anthraquinone donor–acceptor polymers for aluminum dual-ion batteries, revealing how chain architecture, D–A connectivity, and rigidity govern bipolar charge storage. The optimized PTZAQ-C3 enables reversible AlCl₄⁻/AlCl₂⁺ co-storage, delivering 243 mAh g⁻¹, 90,000-cycle stability, and 10.08 mAh cm⁻² at 50.4 mg cm⁻², establishing macromolecular design as a general strategy for high-performance organic cathodes.

Advanced Energy Materials | 🔬 Research Article
💡 The novelty lies in identifying catalytic activity matching, not maximization, as the key design principle for template-catalyzed CVD. The study reveals that scaffold rigidity and coating uniformity compete for finite carbon, quantified via DFT and H₂-TPR. Matching CaSO₄ activity yields uniform coatings and compliant scaffolds, achieving 91.0% initial Coulombic efficiency and 510 Wh kg⁻¹ full cells.

Advanced Energy Materials | 🔬 Research Article | 🔓 Open Access
💡 Graphene mesosponge (GMS) is introduced as a conductive additive that creates a 3D electron/ion transport network in dense, high-loading electrodes. Its deformable mesoporous framework buffers roll-pressing stress, enabling densities above 3.5 g cm⁻³ without particle cracking. Just 1 wt.% GMS boosts conductivity and rate capability beyond carbon nanotubes, offering a transformative route to simultaneously higher energy and power density in practical lithium-ion batteries.
